description: Security domains for different sensitivity levels are not separated. This signal indicates that CUI of varying impact levels may not be adequately isolated from each other.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments with varying data sensitivity. Includes logical and physical separation of security domains, cross-domain solutions, and data classification enforcement.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through security domain architecture review, isolation mechanism verification, and cross-domain flow assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
